linesEn: There they are!
A whole horde of orcs,
and it looks like they're still resting!
Perfect.
Let's go give them a wake-up call!
Don't be so hasty, lad!
We approach cautiously,
then strike when the opening appears!
Right. Let's move in!
Grrragh!
Look alive! Intruders approaching!
All of you, wake up! Battle is upon us!
Huh? Where's their army?
It's just a bunch of brats...
Whatever! Any runts bold enough to approach
knowing our army has gathered here
can't be ordinary children.
Crush them first, ask questions later!
What are you doing here?
Speak up if you value your life!

linesZhTw: 四天前命令我們在此集結，
linesZhCn: 四天前命令我们在此集结，
linesEn: I... I don't know!
Lord Zaka, our chieftain...
ordered us to assemble here four days ago...

linesZhTw: 準備…準備攻打精靈族的都
有一隊伙伴已經先去了，
linesZhCn: 准备…准备攻打精灵族的都
有一队伙伴已经先去了，
linesEn: To prepare... prepare an attack on Hasmir,
the capital of the Elves.
An advance unit was sent ahead,
but they haven't returned yet, and then...
then you lot showed up!

linesZhTw: 光了！那麼，你們的首領薩
卡為何要攻打哈斯米爾？
linesZhCn: 光了！那么，你们的首领萨
卡为何要攻打哈斯米尔？
linesEn: Fools, we slaughtered that vanguard long ago!
Now spill it—why is your chieftain Zaka
attacking Hasmir?
Out with it, right now!

linesZhTw: 只記得首領吩咐隊長的時候
有提到要殺光精靈族以及務
linesZhCn: 只记得首领吩咐队长的时候
有提到要杀光精灵族以及务
linesEn: I... I really don't know much!
I only overheard the chieftain telling the captains
to slaughter the Elves and secure some treasure...

linesZhTw: 必要搶到寶物，其它的我就
linesZhCn: 必要抢到宝物，其它的我就
linesEn: at all costs! That was all I heard,
I swear!
What treasure?

linesZhTw: 求你們饒了我吧，我保證不
會回去向首領通風報信…』
linesZhCn: 求你们饶了我吧，我保证不
会回去向首领通风报信…』
linesEn: H-How could a grunt like me know?!
Please, spare my life! I promise
I won't report back to the chieftain!
Very well.
Answer one more question,
and we'll let you go.
Where is your chieftain Zaka right now?

linesZhTw: 隊到拉卡湖去攻打豹人族了
如果沒錯的話，他應該還在
linesZhCn: 队到拉卡湖去攻打豹人族了
如果没错的话，他应该还在
linesEn: The chieftain... he led another detachment
to Lake Raka to attack the Panther clan.
If I'm not mistaken, he should still be...
...somewhere in that area.
I've told you everything I know!
Can I go now?
Fine. You may leave.
Now beat it!
Th-Thank you!
Thor! How could you let him go
without asking the rest of us?!

linesZhTw: 知道了，不過情況好像更加
linesZhCn: 知道了，不过情况好像更加
linesEn: It is fine. We got the answers we needed.
Still, the situation appears far more troublesome
than we anticipated...

linesZhTw: 『獸人族是吃了什麼熊心豹子
膽，竟敢同時攻打精靈族和
linesZhCn: 『兽人族是吃了什么熊心豹子
胆，竟敢同时攻打精灵族和
linesEn: What's gotten into these orcs?
To have the sheer nerve to wage war on both
the Elves and the Panther clan at once!

linesZhTw: 指使，不然獸人族那來這麼
linesZhCn: 指使，不然兽人族那来这么
linesEn: Someone must be pulling the strings from the shadows.
Orcs on their own would never have
such audacity.

linesZhTw: 『豹人族的戰鬥力在這大陸的
幾個種族中雖然也是數一數
二的，但這種規模的攻擊他
linesZhCn: 『豹人族的战斗力在这大陆的
几个种族中虽然也是数一数
二的，但这种规模的攻击他
linesEn: The warriors of the Panther clan are among the fiercest
on the continent, but against an assault
of this scale...

linesZhTw: 們也未必擋得住，我們還是
必要時還可以支援他們。』
linesZhCn: 们也未必挡得住，我们还是
必要时还可以支援他们。』
linesEn: ...even they might not hold out.
We should head for Lake Raka at once
and lend them our support if needed.

linesZhTw: 像有個小村落，我們可以先
linesZhCn: 像有个小村落，我们可以先
linesEn: Lake Raka is not far from here.
There is a small hamlet along the way
where we can rest for a moment.
Then what are we waiting for? Let's move!
